externalCodePrefixes.summary: Python semantic diagnostics retained from the pinned ty analyzer. The suffix and message remain provider-owned.

diagnostics.title: Invalid template syntax
diagnostics.summary: The Citry parser could not parse the template at the reported source range.
diagnostics.when: Citry encounters malformed template markup, an incomplete expression, or another template grammar error.

diagnostics.title: Invalid template value
diagnostics.summary: The parser received a template value that cannot be represented by Citry's template model.
diagnostics.when: A parser API receives a value that it cannot convert into Citry template source or a supported template value.

diagnostics.title: Template parser configuration failed
diagnostics.summary: Project-specific parser configuration could not be constructed or applied.
diagnostics.when: Citry cannot build the parser rules required by the selected application or component registry.

diagnostics.title: Unknown template variable
diagnostics.summary: A parser-proven root variable is not declared by every component that consumes the template.
diagnostics.when: A name used in an interpolation or Python-valued template attribute is absent from the proven template data, configured globals, and lint-only variables.

messages.closed: Template variable '{name}' is not available in this template.
messages.allow-extra: Template variable '{name}' is not declared. It may be supplied dynamically.
messages.unknown: Template variable '{name}' is not declared. Citry could not determine whether it is supplied dynamically.

examples.title: Unknown name in a dynamic attribute

diagnostics.title: Unknown component
diagnostics.summary: A component tag is not registered in the selected Citry registry.
diagnostics.when: A template uses a component tag whose name is absent from the selected application or library registry.

parameters.tag: Authored component tag, including the c- prefix.

diagnostics.title: JsData field is not a JSON type
diagnostics.summary: A declared or inferred JsData value cannot be represented safely by Citry's JSON wire format.
diagnostics.when: A JsData field has a type that strict JSON serialization cannot carry, such as bytes, a set, a callable, or a date/time object without an explicit conversion.

parameters.name: JsData field name.
parameters.detail: Why the value is not a clean JSON type.

messages.default: JsData field '{name}' is not a clean JSON value: {detail}. Browser tooling will treat its type as unknown.

examples.title: Unsupported set value

diagnostics.title: Unknown Alpine variable
diagnostics.summary: A free identifier in an Alpine expression is absent from the component's proven browser scope.
diagnostics.when: An Alpine expression references a root that is not supplied by JsData, x-data, an enclosing x-for, a proven $component scope write, an Alpine or Citry magic, a browser global, or configured lint-only Alpine variables.

messages.default: Alpine variable '{name}' is not available in this component.

examples.title: Unknown name in an Alpine expression

diagnostics.title: Browser code is incompatible with strict CSP
diagnostics.summary: An Alpine or Citry browser expression uses a host or source form unsupported by the pinned Alpine CSP evaluator.
diagnostics.when: The selected Citry application configures CSP warning or strict mode and a source-classifiable browser expression is incompatible with Alpine CSP 3.16.2.

parameters.detail: The unsupported directive, host, token, or operation.

messages.default: Alpine CSP 3.16.2 cannot evaluate {detail} here. Move complex logic to Component.js and call a scope method from the template.

examples.title: Move an arrow function into Component.js

diagnostics.title: Unknown component JavaScript variable
diagnostics.summary: A free identifier inside a $component initializer is absent from its lexical scope and configured globals.
diagnostics.when: A $component initializer references a name that was not declared locally, destructured from the callback context, supplied by the JavaScript or browser environment, or configured as a lint-only component JavaScript global.

messages.default: Component JavaScript variable '{name}' is not defined.

diagnostics.title: Unknown server event
diagnostics.summary: A literal browser event reference names no effective handler on the component that owns it.
diagnostics.when: An Alpine expression or component JavaScript calls sendEvent, $sendEvent, $loading, or $error with an unknown non-empty string literal, or a declarative @c-* binding names an unknown handler.

messages.default: Server event '{name}' is not declared by this component.

diagnostics.title: Unknown client prop
diagnostics.summary: A static $c-props object contains a key that the child component does not declare.
diagnostics.when: A statically resolved component receives a direct $c-props object key absent from its static $component({props}) declaration.

messages.default: Client prop '{name}' is not declared by <{tag}>.

diagnostics.title: Missing required client prop
diagnostics.summary: A static $c-props object omits a required prop declared by the child component.
diagnostics.when: A statically resolved component receives a direct $c-props object without a required static $component({props}) key and no dynamic spread can supply it.

messages.default: Required client prop '{name}' is missing for <{tag}>.

diagnostics.title: Incompatible client prop
diagnostics.summary: A static $c-props value has a proven type outside the child component's prop declaration.
diagnostics.when: Citry can prove both the authored value type and the static $component({props}) type, and the value cannot satisfy that prop.

messages.default: Client prop '{name}' expects {expected}, but this value is {actual}.

diagnostics.title: Template declaration unavailable
diagnostics.summary: The checker could not safely inspect or identify a component's template declaration.
diagnostics.when: The selected component's template or template_file declaration raises during inspection or cannot be identified safely.

messages.default: Citry could not inspect this component's template declaration: {detail}

diagnostics.title: Unsupported template language
diagnostics.summary: The checker only analyzes native Citry templates and skipped a declaration with another language.
diagnostics.when: A component sets template_lang to a non-None value; citry check currently analyzes only native Citry templates.

parameters.type: Runtime type of the non-None template_lang value.

messages.default: Citry cannot check template_lang with a {type} value. This template was skipped.

diagnostics.title: Invalid template declaration value
diagnostics.summary: A template or template_file declaration has a value type the checker cannot use.
diagnostics.when: Component.template is not a string, or Component.template_file is neither a string nor a pathlib.Path.

messages.inline: Component.template must be a string. This template was skipped.
messages.file: Component.template_file must be a string or Path. This template was skipped.

diagnostics.title: Template file not found
diagnostics.summary: No template file exists at any location resolved from template_file.
diagnostics.when: Component.template_file points to a path that does not exist in the component directory or any configured template directory.

messages.default: Template file '{path}' was not found. Searched: {locations}.

diagnostics.title: Template file could not be read
diagnostics.summary: The resolved template file could not be opened or decoded as UTF-8.
diagnostics.when: Citry resolves Component.template_file but cannot open the file or decode it as UTF-8.

messages.default: Citry could not read this template file: {detail}

diagnostics.title: Template variables unavailable
diagnostics.summary: The checker could not determine the variables supplied to a component template.
diagnostics.when: citry check cannot inspect the component's declared or inferred template data namespace.

messages.default: Citry could not inspect this template's variables: {detail}

diagnostics.title: Python source could not be analyzed
diagnostics.summary: Static checking could not read, decode, or parse a Python source file.
diagnostics.when: Static discovery reaches a Python file that cannot be read, decoded, or parsed.

messages.default: Citry could not analyze this Python source: {detail}

diagnostics.title: Invalid Fluent catalog source
diagnostics.summary: A Fluent source unit failed Citry's production parser or i18n contract checks.
diagnostics.when: A messages block or catalog file contains invalid Fluent syntax, an unsupported parameter type, or another source-level i18n error.

diagnostics.title: Unknown i18n message
diagnostics.summary: A literal translation key is absent from the checked project catalog.
diagnostics.when: A direct tr() call, <c-trans> tag, $c-tr binding, or bounded browser bind() call names a message value or attribute that no component or configured catalog package defines.

diagnostics.title: Invalid i18n argument
diagnostics.summary: A translation binding, formatter, parser, or rich-message call does not match its checked contract.
diagnostics.when: A literal i18n call or $c-tr binding is malformed, has missing, unknown, or mistyped message inputs, uses an unknown named profile, or supplies the wrong <c-trans> values or fills.

diagnostics.title: Cross-language i18n fallback
diagnostics.summary: A plain translated string falls back to a different language without a place to carry that language metadata.
diagnostics.when: A text-only translation can select a source or fallback locale whose canonical language tag differs from the requested locale.

diagnostics.title: Invalid client i18n message
diagnostics.summary: A message declared for browser use is missing or lacks complete locale coverage.
diagnostics.when: Component.I18n.client_messages names an unknown output or an output that would fall back across languages in a client-enabled subtree.

diagnostics.title: Invalid template syntax
diagnostics.summary: Formatting stopped because the template does not parse.
diagnostics.when: A format command receives a template with a Citry syntax error.

diagnostics.title: Invalid formatter directive
diagnostics.summary: A fmt directive is unmatched or appears in a context where its requested scope is invalid.
diagnostics.when: A fmt:on, fmt:off, or fmt:skip directive has no valid matching scope at its authored position.

diagnostics.title: Formatter safety check failed
diagnostics.summary: The formatter refused to write output after an internal span, structure, or idempotence check failed.
diagnostics.when: Formatting output fails one of Citry's safety checks, so Citry refuses to apply the edit.

diagnostics.title: Formatting shape unsupported
diagnostics.summary: The formatter conservatively declined a valid template shape it cannot yet rewrite safely.
diagnostics.when: The template is valid, but its source shape is outside the formatter's currently supported rewrite rules.

diagnostics.title: Embedded formatter returned invalid output
diagnostics.summary: A JavaScript or CSS formatter response failed Citry's source-bound validation.
diagnostics.when: A delegated JavaScript or CSS formatter returns an edit that does not match the requested embedded region.

diagnostics.title: Embedded formatting suppressed
diagnostics.summary: A fmt directive deliberately prevented formatting of a JavaScript or CSS region.
diagnostics.when: A fmt:off or fmt:skip directive covers an embedded JavaScript or CSS region.

diagnostics.title: Embedded language unsupported
diagnostics.summary: Citry recognized an embedded region but cannot delegate its declared language.
diagnostics.when: An embedded script or style region declares a language for which Citry has no formatter provider.

diagnostics.title: Embedded interpolation unsupported
diagnostics.summary: A JavaScript or CSS region contains Citry interpolation that cannot be safely delegated yet.
diagnostics.when: An embedded JavaScript or CSS region contains Citry interpolation, which cannot yet be mapped safely through an external formatter.

diagnostics.title: Embedded formatter unavailable
diagnostics.summary: No JavaScript or CSS formatter returned a usable result for a delegated region.
diagnostics.when: Citry asks the editor to format embedded JavaScript or CSS, but no installed provider returns an edit.

diagnostics.title: Invalid Python host syntax
diagnostics.summary: A Python file containing component assets could not be parsed before formatting.
diagnostics.when: A format command targets a Python file whose current source has invalid Python syntax.

diagnostics.title: Document is not eligible for formatting
diagnostics.summary: The selected document, position, or asset is outside Citry's proven formatting scope.
diagnostics.when: Citry cannot prove that the selected document or cursor position belongs to a supported Citry template, script, or style region.

diagnostics.title: Document changed during formatting
diagnostics.summary: Formatting was discarded because its source-bound plan no longer matches the current document.
diagnostics.when: The document changes after Citry prepares a format plan but before the editor can apply it.

diagnostics.title: Formatting cancelled
diagnostics.summary: The editor cancelled a formatting operation before Citry could apply it.
diagnostics.when: The editor or user cancels a format request before Citry applies its edits.
